Skar'this is a naga and a servant of Neptulon appearing in the Slave Pens. He usually appears as Skar'this the Heretic, a friendly naga quest giver. He can be found in a cage shortly before Rokmar the Crackler. He also appears during the Midsummer Fire Festival as Skar'this the Summoner, a hostile mob this time. As adventurers show up, he can be seen using an Ice Stone to summon Lord Ahune. He drops no particular loot, and enjoys to repeatedly cast Frostbolt.

The Skadir are a kvaldir clan led by Gamel the Cruel, and located on the Riplash Strand of the Borean Tundra. Prior to the war against the Lich King, while Arthas woke the vrykul, it was the simple greed of the Northsea Freebooters' pirates that brought the kvaldir to Northrend's shores, as they stole artifacts from a vrykul burial ground and disturbed the spirits of the dead. One of those kvaldir clans, the Skadir, brought their longships to shore at the Riplash Ruins, wiped out the Riplash naga (leaving only Veehja), and took the ruins for themselves, using them as a staging ground for their attacks on the Borean Tundra. Skeletal gryphons are undead gryphons. Gryphons can also become spectral gryphons in undeath.

Skardyn are the cursed descendants of Dark Iron dwarves who had survived the Dark Iron siege of Grim Batol, near the end of the War of the Three Hammers (less than 230 years before the First War).

The Sister Mercy is a ghost ship found sailing just north of Scalawag Point in Howling Fjord. The crew was killed about a month prior to the adventurers' arrival, most likely by Sorlof, who is now holding treasure taken from the pirates. Cursed by The Shield of the Aesirites these once Northsea Freebooters will not rest until they reclaim what is rightfully theirs. Below deck the gunners have mutinied leaving the rest of the crew forced to deal with them and Sorlof. This is where the adventurer helps, by getting the blasting powder from the gunners to use on The Big Gun to kill the giant and bring back the treasure to the captain so that they might finally rest in peace.
__NOTOC__ Skeletal Reavers are large skeletal giants found patrolling The Conflagration in Icecrown.
Skeletal Marksmen are skeleton marksmen creeps that can be encountered in the Dungeon, Underground and Northrend tilesets.
Skeleton Archers is a category for creeps found in Warcraft III. It includes Skeleton Archers, Skeletal Marksmen and Burning Archers.

Skeletal Summoners were skeletal mages located in Razorfen Downs. They are among the craftier enemies found in the instance, and as the name suggests, they have potent summoning skills. It would be recommended to finishing them first to prevent them from summoning more than you can handle. While they don't have Splinterbone in their names, they are probably part of the Splinterbone skeletons unit.

Skeletal Shadowcasters are spawned by the Skeletal Summoners in the Spiral of Thorns in Razorfen Downs. Despite their lack of Elite status, these fragile skeletons can be quite dangerous. If Amplify Damage is cast on the Tank, the results could spell disaster for your group. These are probably also Splinterbone skeletons.
Skeletal Archmages are found at The Court of Bones in Icecrown.
Skeletal Highborne are Shen'dralar night elves unfortunate enough not to stay dead. They roam Dire Maul.
Skeletal Slaves are skeletons located in the Pit of Saron. Groups of six slaves are led around southwest of the pit by Deathwhisper Necrolytes.

Sister Svalna can be found in Frostwing Halls of Icecrown Citadel, where she guards the way to where Valithria Dreamwalker is kept imprisoned. She appears to be a former acquaintance of Crok Scourgebane from when he was in service to the Scourge. While fighting through the enemies leading up to her, adventurers are aided by the Argent Crusade captains Arnath, Brandon, Grondel, and Rupert. Sister Svalna will throw her spear at one of these four at random, instantly killing him. Taking too long in clearing the trash will result in a second and possibly third spear throw (in addition to a higher chance that the captains will die through sheer damage). The Skeleton King is a skeleton in Warcraft III, leading a Corrupted Ancients base full of skeletons. It's found in A Destiny of Flame and Sorrow.
Skeletal Woodcutters are skeletons found in central Crystalsong Forest.

The Skeletal Reef is a reef with several sunken ships scatter the grounds in eastern Kelp'thar Forest. The area contains a cursed treasure that when touched will turn them into skeletons. Several pirates and even schools of fish have become cursed. Should they leave the reef, they would be forever cursed, however King Gurboggle holds the secret to removing the hex. Here many sharks roam the feeding ground including the great white beast Gnaws, whose favorite food are the nearby sea grubs.

While some men were captured, Sister Quan-li was able to bring the rest of the group back to their bases. Skeletal Minions are skeletal warriors located in Icecrown, Utgarde Keep, and Old Stratholme during the Culling of Stratholme, summoned by Grimkor the Wicked, Dalronn the Controller, and Master Necromancers respectively.

Skeletal Hands can be looted from Mardivas's Universally Lauded Tote and Glimmering Chests in Nazjatar. The hands are cursed and will apply various nasty effects to adventurers lucky enough to find them. They can be handed in to Gloomseeker Yarga in exchange for a Jingling Sack.
Sister Vaile is a dead tidesage being eaten by Taja the Tidehowler in the Windshorn Hills in Stormsong Valley.

The Siren's Daughter is a Kul Tiran battleship. The Horde lured Katherine Proudmoore into sending her army into Plunder Harbor, and she sent the Siren's Daughter and the Valorous Rose to attack the pirate harbor. It acts as a flagship and is bigger than her companion.
Sivara's Slitherblade drops from Abyssal Commander Sivara in the Eternal Palace.

Sister Paxton is a k'thir located in Stormsong Valley. She intended to stop Taelia, Tideguard Victoria, and the Alliance adventurer on their way to the Shrine of the Storm but was killed in the progress.
Siren Mystic's Vestments drops from Abyssal Commander Sivara in the Eternal Palace.
__NOTOC__ Sister Absinthe is a human located in Stormsong Valley.
